Subject: Need help with a cheque bounce case

Hello, my name is Priyanka Rane. I am a 40-year-old schoolteacher living in Thiruvananthapuram. Farhan Khan gave me a cheque for ₹16,20,000 to repay a loan, but the drawer stopped the cheque with a stop-payment instruction. Can your firm advise me on what to do next? You can call me on 83019 89885 or email priyanka.rane@example.in.
